summary: US-002: Create and publish a GA event
description:
**As** an organizer, **I want** to create a venue, event, performance and GA ticket type via the catalog API and see it listed on the storefront.

**Priority:** P0
**Depends on:** US-001 (TKT-25)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Catalog API: create venue (GA capacity), event, dated performance, ticket type with EUR price; persisted; OpenAPI contract published
- [ ] Publishing a performance emits a domain event; storefront lists published performances with name/date/price (browser-verified)
- [ ] Public catalog reads (event list, event detail) carry explicit Cache-Control TTLs per ADR-004 tiers; the storefront page issues one aggregated call and does not re-fetch within the TTL
- [ ] Event content fields are localizable; the storefront renders FR and EN (locale switch) with locale-aware date/money formatting (TKT-36 plumbing born here)
- [ ] Entities carry an organizer_id even though v1 has one organizer

Quality gates: `make check` green (defined in US-001, mirrors CI); contract tests for touched service boundaries; UI: browser-verified with screenshot in PR; money paths: NF525 journal chain verifies (from US-004).

binding.rule: We adopt Go for all backend services and TypeScript + React for the three frontends (storefront, back office, scanner). Money is represented as integer minor units + ISO currency code everywhere; floats are banned on money paths.

We build five Go services (catalog, inventory, commerce, payments, access) behind an API gateway, with an event bus for the domain event stream; every entity carries a tenant/organizer id from day one. Docker Compose only.

Every public read endpoint declares a volatility-tiered TTL with explicit Cache-Control (seat maps: hours; event lists/detail: minutes; price display: ~1 min; availability: seconds; hold/order/scan state: never cached); hot events are served from in-memory structures refreshed/invalidated from the write path; frontends make few aggregated calls (one per page view, not per widget) and refresh on the endpoint's TTL cadence; writes are never cached.

Every admission-granting offer (performance, festival day, park operating day) is a dated slot in one inventory machinery; passes are entitlements to claim slot entries; lodging/day resources reserve through the same contention-safe core; slot attributes carry domain specifics — the claim primitive does not fork.

<!-- sdlc:stage=planning kind=plan -->
## Execution plan — US-002: Create and publish a GA event

**Grounding (verified in-repo):** catalog `main.go` is a skeleton with chi/pgx/NATS wired, zero domain routes; gateway's route table already reserves `/api/catalog/` and its header says "real public contracts arrive with US-002's OpenAPI work"; `web/storefront` is a static nginx placeholder NOT in the pnpm workspace; no migration tooling exists anywhere; the PLATFORM stream (`platform.>`) is provisioned at stack init; catalog DB + role exist (`deploy/postgres-init`); the smoke suite runs `-tags smoke` against an isolated compose stack with host-built artifacts; plain `go test` (test-go) runs with **no DB or Docker available**.

### Test seams (chosen first)

1. **Primary: the existing smoke suite** (`smoke/smoke_test.go`) — the whole AC path through the real gateway: create venue→event→performance→ticket type via `/api/catalog/*`, publish, assert the domain event on the PLATFORM stream, assert the storefront HTML (FR + EN) lists name/date/price, assert Cache-Control tiers. Highest existing seam; no new seam invented.
2. **Catalog unit seam:** handlers tested with `httptest` against the chi router + a **repo interface fake** (test-go has no Postgres). Real SQL is exercised only in smoke (real Postgres 18.4). Event emission tested with a publisher-port fake.
3. **Storefront unit seam:** vitest (same toolchain as scanner: oxlint/vitest/tsc) for locale-aware date/money formatting (integer minor units → display, no floats) and the SSR TTL-cache module.

### Design decisions (approve at Gate 2; each gets a mini-ADR)

- **ADR-008 — migrations:** `pressly/goose` v3 as a library, SQL files embedded (`embed.FS`) in the service binary, applied at startup before listen. No separate migrate container; per-service ownership matches ADR-007. Includes a seed migration inserting the single v1 organizer (AC5).
- **ADR-009 — contract-first APIs:** OpenAPI 3.1 spec is the source of truth at `services/catalog/api/openapi.yaml`; `oapi-codegen` v2 generates the chi server interface + types; kin-openapi request-validation middleware enforces the spec at runtime; the spec is served at `GET /api/catalog/openapi.yaml` ("published" = committed + served). Storefront TS types generated via `openapi-typescript` (committed, regenerated by script).

### Domain model (catalog schema, all rows carry `organizer_id`)

`organizers` · `venues` (GA capacity int) · `events` (content as per-locale JSONB `{fr:{name,description},en:{...}}` — new locales without schema change, TKT-36) · `performances` (dated slot per ADR-005: `starts_at timestamptz`, `timezone`, `status draft|published`, `published_at`; no concert-specific fields — must not preclude festival/park days) · `ticket_types` (name localized JSONB, `price_amount bigint` minor units + `currency char(3)`, ADR-001).

### API surface (v1, no auth — trusted local API, out of scope per DoR)

Writes: `POST /venues`, `POST /events`, `POST /performances`, `POST /ticket-types`, `POST /performances/{id}/publish`. Publish flips status and emits the domain event.
Public reads (aggregated, one call per page view per ADR-004): `GET /public/performances?locale=` (list: everything the list page needs) and `GET /public/performances/{id}?locale=` (detail). Both carry the **minutes tier**: `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300`. Writes + publish: `Cache-Control: no-store`.

### Domain event (first one — sets the envelope precedent)

Subject `platform.catalog.performance.published` (fits the provisioned `platform.>`). Envelope: `{id, type, occurred_at, data:{performance_id, event_id, organizer_id}, schema: 1}`. Published to JetStream **after** the DB commit — plain publish, no outbox yet: at-least-once is not guaranteed and that is **recorded as a known deferral** (ADR-007 anticipates outboxes "in later stories"; US-004's journal work is where reliability machinery lands). No consumer exists in M1; smoke asserts the message on the stream directly (pattern already in `TestJetStreamPersists`).

### Storefront (Astro 7 shell — first real ADR-006 integration)

- New Astro app replaces the placeholder: `astro@7.0.7`, `@astrojs/node` (standalone), `@astrojs/react`, real `i18n.routing` (locales `fr`/`en`, `prefixDefaultLocale: true`). Routes: `/[locale]/events` (list), `/[locale]/events/[id]` (detail), locale switch in the layout. Joins `pnpm-workspace.yaml` → `pnpm -r lint/test/build` covers it (gate unchanged in shape).
- **Caching ownership declaration (required by ADR-006 for every storefront story):** this story's reads are event list + detail, minutes tier ⇒ **page-layer owned, SSR-embedded** (price included — single-source: the page's one aggregated read carries it; the public API copy of the same read is the page's *source*, not a second independently-cached browser-side copy — no island fetches it). No availability anywhere (that island arrives in US-003). `src/middleware.ts` sets `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300` on event pages, `no-store` elsewhere; `/healthz` route added (no-store).
- **AC3 "no re-fetch within TTL":** SSR in-memory TTL cache keyed by (route-class, locale), honoring the API response's `max-age`. Unit-tested in vitest; smoke asserts headers on both HTML and API, and best-effort asserts the no-refetch behavior by hitting the page twice and querying Prometheus for the catalog request-count delta (dropped if flaky — the TTL cache unit test + headers are the reliable assertions).
- SSR fetches go **through the gateway** (`GATEWAY_URL=http://gateway:8080` in compose) — the storefront consumes the public contract (ADR-002); no compose deadlock since both healthchecks are self-only.
- **Containers:** hermetic `web/storefront/Dockerfile` (pnpm build in-image, node runtime running `dist/server/entry.mjs`); fast-path `Dockerfile.smoke` copying host-built `dist/` (scanner pattern); compose healthcheck kept wget-compatible (alpine node image).

### Gateway

No route change needed (`/api/catalog/` exists; prefix-strip verified in code). Only compose env additions.

### Steps (TDD order)

1. ADR-008 + ADR-009 committed (Proposed → Accepted at Gate 2).
2. Catalog: failing handler tests (httptest + repo fake) → spec → generated server → domain logic → migrations → real repo (pgx).
3. Publish flow: failing test with publisher fake → NATS publisher impl.
4. Storefront: vitest for formatting + TTL cache → Astro app → pages → middleware.
5. Smoke: extend with the full create→publish→storefront flow, header/tier assertions, FR+EN, stream assertion; update `TestStorefrontServedThroughGateway` (placeholder text goes away).
6. Compose + workspace wiring; `make check` green end-to-end; browser screenshot for the PR (chrome-devtools).

### Pre-mortem (lens: pre-mortem — assume Gate 2/3 bounced; what went wrong?)

1. **Biggest story yet — diff too big to review.** Three surfaces is inherent to the walking skeleton (vertical by design), but reviewability is managed: commits stratified per surface (ADRs / catalog / storefront / smoke), review-guide walks by concern. If Gate 2 judges it too big anyway: natural split = catalog API+event (a) / storefront slice (b). Flagged, not chosen — the story is demoable only whole, and M1 stories are deliberately vertical.
2. **Gate speed regression (TKT-42 just fixed it).** Astro build (~800 npm packages) joins `pnpm -r build`, a second web container joins smoke. Mitigations: `Dockerfile.smoke` host-built fast path; CI pnpm cache already exists. I will measure `make check` before/after and report the delta in the PR; if warm-gate time regresses badly, that's a Gate 3 conversation, not a silent cost.
3. **Real-integration surprises the spike explicitly did not cover** (its risk register): Astro SSR fetch against the real Go gateway (error/latency behavior), `X-Forwarded-*` handling, path handling for `/api/catalog/openapi.yaml` through the prefix-strip. Mitigated: smoke exercises exactly this path; failures surface in the gate, not at demo time.
4. **Catalog SQL bugs found only in smoke** (unit seam uses a repo fake). Accepted trade-off (test-go has no DB); the smoke flow covers every query this story adds. If smoke-only coverage proves too coarse, a build-tagged repo integration test against the smoke stack's Postgres is the escape hatch — noted, not built now.
5. **Event envelope becomes accidental precedent.** First domain event on the bus — the envelope shape will be copied by US-003..006. Kept minimal + versioned (`schema: 1`), and ADR-009 documents it so the precedent is deliberate.

**Deviations/deferrals recorded:** no outbox (publish-after-commit, at-least-once NOT guaranteed — deferred to US-004's reliability work); no auth on write endpoints (v1 trusted local); Prometheus no-refetch smoke assertion is best-effort.

<!-- sdlc:stage=plan-review kind=plan-final -->
## Plan revised after codex cross-model critique

Codex verdict: **unsound as written, repairable** — 12 findings (1 blocking, 10 significant, 1 minor). All 12 verified against the repo and **accepted**; none rejected. The blocking one was a genuine correctness bug in the plan. Revisions:

**1. Cache key aliasing (blocking).** The SSR cache key was `(route-class, locale)` — `/fr/events/B` would serve A's name/price for 5 minutes. **Fixed: key = the full request URL** (locale + route + id); stated as the rule "the cache key includes every representation selector".

**2+3. Single cache owner + remaining-freshness propagation (ADR-006 clause 3 / ADR-004 rule 1).** Layered independent caches (SSR data cache 300s + browser/CDN HTML cache 300s) could double effective staleness to ~10 min. **Fixed: the storefront SSR page-data cache is the single cache owner of the minutes tier.** The catalog API's `Cache-Control: public, max-age=300, s-maxage=300` (s-maxage added per ADR-004 "CDN-ready") governs that cache; the HTML response's `max-age`/`s-maxage` is the **remaining** freshness of the data it embeds (`300 − data age`), so total staleness can never exceed the tier. The API's only consumer is the page's SSR read — no browser-side copy exists (single-source holds structurally).

**4. AC3 verification is now mandatory + deterministic**, not best-effort: (a) vitest spy-fetch test — N identical requests within TTL ⇒ exactly 1 upstream call; (b) the page emits an `X-Page-Data-Age` debug header; smoke hits the page twice and asserts the second response's age > 0 (served from the SSR cache, no catalog re-fetch). The flaky Prometheus-delta idea is dropped.

**5. Public contract is event-rooted, as the AC says.** `GET /public/events?locale=` (published events, each with upcoming performances + from-price) and `GET /public/events/{id}?locale=` (event detail: venue, all published performances, each with its ticket types/prices). Storefront detail route is `/[locale]/events/[eventId]`. Cardinality defined: an event with two performances appears once, listing both slots; displayed price = each performance's ticket-type prices (v1: one type ⇒ one price, list shows "from" min).

**6. Browser verification is a defined flow, not one screenshot:** scripted browser session (chrome-devtools) — load `/fr/events` → locale-switch to EN (link must preserve the route) → navigate to detail → assert localized name/description, `Intl` date and EUR money rendering in both locales; FR + EN screenshots attached to the PR. Smoke keeps the raw-HTML assertions.

**7. Contract drift is gate-enforced.** oapi-codegen + openapi-typescript pinned; generation via `make generate`; a drift check joins `make check` (regenerate → `git diff --exit-code` on generated files). Response conformance: kin-openapi **response** validation wrapped around handler tests (not just request validation); smoke asserts the spec served through the gateway is byte-identical to the committed file.

**8+9. Build/smoke wiring completed (was silently missing):** storefront compose build context changes to root (`context: ., dockerfile: web/storefront/Dockerfile`, scanner pattern — required for pnpm workspace COPY); `compose.smoke.yaml` gains the storefront `Dockerfile.smoke` override; `scripts/smoke.sh` preflights `web/storefront/dist`; `make clean` covers it.

**10. JetStream assertion is race-free and correlated:** smoke creates a filtered ephemeral consumer on `platform.catalog.performance.published` **before** acting, then creates+publishes a uniquely-named performance and matches `data.performance_id` in the received envelope (pattern of the existing `TestJetStreamPersists`). Publish itself is **JetStream ack'd publish** (synchronous `js.Publish`), not fire-and-forget — the stream durably has the event on the happy path; the outbox deferral now covers only crash-between-commit-and-publish (still recorded, US-004).

**11. Tenancy semantics made explicit:** `organizers` is the tenant root (no self-referential organizer_id — the plan's "all rows" wording was wrong). Write payloads carry a required `organizer_id` (FK-validated); cross-entity relations are validated same-organizer (performance↔event↔venue, ticket-type↔performance); public reads are cross-organizer but scoped `status=published`; no hard-coded seeded ID in repositories — the seed is data, not code.

**12. OpenAPI path vs prefix-strip:** catalog registers `GET /openapi.yaml`; the public URL is `/api/catalog/openapi.yaml` (gateway strips the prefix); smoke tests it through the gateway.

Everything else in the kind=plan comment stands (seams, ADR-008 goose / ADR-009 contract-first, schema, event envelope, Astro shell, steps, pre-mortem). Pre-mortem lens line: pre-mortem lens applied in the draft (5 causes, 2 absorbed into the design); the codex pass then forced the six design-level revisions above — the two passes caught disjoint problems, as intended.

**→ needs:human — Gate 2: approve the plan (incl. ADR-008/ADR-009) to move Building.**

<!-- sdlc:stage=coding kind=summary -->
**Built, gate green, PR #5 open.** All five ACs implemented and verified at three seams.

- **Catalog:** OpenAPI contract (source of truth, ADR-009) -> generated chi server; goose migrations embedded, run at startup (ADR-008); publish idempotent on the resource / at-least-once on the event (emission marker retried via re-POST; ack'd JetStream publish); event-rooted aggregated public reads at the minutes tier; tenancy enforced. 12 handler tests incl. spec response-validation, emission-retry, draft/unpriced invisibility.
- **Storefront:** Astro 7.0.7 SSR shell (real APIs: src/middleware.ts, i18n.routing, @astrojs/node — per the corrected ADR-006). SSR page-data cache keyed by FULL url = the single cache owner; HTML Cache-Control carries REMAINING freshness (no staleness stacking); X-Page-Data-Age for observability; upstream failure = explicit 503 no-store. Vitest: 12 tests (money from minor units with integer-only arithmetic incl. JPY zero-decimal + float rejection; cache single-flight, key-aliasing regression, no-store, expiry).
- **Smoke (primary seam):** full US-002 flow through the real gateway — create -> publish -> event on PLATFORM (consumer pre-created, DeliverNew, correlated by performance id) -> FR+EN rendered HTML with localized date/money -> tier headers on API and HTML -> no-refetch-within-TTL -> served spec byte-identical -> tenancy rejection -> draft invisibility. `make check` exit 0, warm ~1m10s (no TKT-42 regression).
- **Browser-verified** (real Chrome through the real gateway): FR list -> locale switch preserves the deep route -> EN detail; correct Intl date in the performance timezone and money in both locales. Screenshots committed under docs/verification/TKT-26/ and linked in the PR.

Deviations from plan (both narrowing, none of scope): emission marker (event_emitted_at) upgrades the no-outbox deferral from lose-on-any-failure to lose-only-on-crash-between-commit-and-ack; vite ssr.noExternal bundles SSR deps so runtime images ship dist only (fixes react-not-found in the packaging images). Next: codex adversarial review of the diff.

<!-- sdlc:stage=ai-review kind=summary -->
**Codex review triaged — 7 findings: 5 fixed & re-verified, 2 rejected as approved deferrals. → needs:human (Gate 3).**

| # | Finding | Verdict | Action |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Not at-least-once; retry/race emits new envelope id (no dedup) | partially valid | **Fixed the fixable half:** envelope id now deterministic per publication (uuid5 of perf id + published_at) + doubles as Nats-Msg-Id (stream-window dedup). **Rejected the rest:** crash-between-commit-and-ack has no recovery — that is the Gate-2-approved deferral, recorded in ADR-009, owed to US-004's outbox. |
| 2 | Publish-before-priced emits an event for a slot the storefront hides; never corrected | valid, blocking | **Fixed:** publish without a ticket type -> 409 (spec + store + tests). Event and visibility can no longer disagree. |
| 3 | SSR cache stampede on concurrent miss (hot event at on-sale boundary) | valid | **Fixed:** single-flight; failures shared but never cached. 2 new vitest cases. |
| 4 | int64 Money exceeds JS safe integers | valid | **Fixed:** contract bounds amount to 2^53-1 (validated at the API edge). |
| 5 | Unauthenticated writes, caller-supplied organizer_id | valid observation | **Rejected for this PR:** explicit DoR/plan deferral approved at Gate 2 ("v1 trusted local API"); auth is owned by the back-office/RBAC epic (TKT-22). |
| 6 | No request body size limit | valid | **Fixed:** 1 MiB MaxBytesReader on the API surface. |
| 7 | Committed .astro/ generated file w/ trailing whitespace | valid | **Fixed:** untracked + gitignored. |

One codex pass per stage (rule followed — fixes verified by the gate, not a second codex run). `make check` green after fixes, warm ~1m12s. Fix commit pushed; review-guide posted on PR #5. **Stopped pushing.**

**Gate 3 is yours:** review + squash-merge PR #5, then move the ticket to PO Review.

<!-- sdlc:stage=po-review kind=summary -->
**Validation note — COS met, from the user-visible output:**
- AC1/AC2: created + published "Nuit Électrique" through the public API; it appears on the storefront in a real browser (screenshots in the PR and `docs/verification/TKT-26/`). The publication event was observed on the PLATFORM stream, correlated by performance id (smoke, part of the merged gate).
- AC3: `curl -sI /api/catalog/public/events?locale=fr` and the event pages show the minutes tier; two page hits show `X-Page-Data-Age` advancing with remaining-freshness `max-age` (no re-fetch within TTL).
- AC4: FR/EN locale switch preserves the deep route; date renders in the performance's timezone per locale; money renders from integer minor units (45,50 EUR / EUR45.50).
- AC5: every entity row carries organizer_id; cross-organizer wiring rejected (smoke-asserted).
Demo stack: localhost:8080 (Postgres host port 15433 this run). **PO accepted in-session (owner, 2026-07-12).**

objective.note: First real vertical slice after the scaffold: catalog write path -> domain event -> cacheable public reads -> Astro storefront listing. M1 walking skeleton, P0.

scope.note: IN: catalog API create venue(GA capacity)/event/dated performance/ticket type (single EUR price, integer minor units); publish emits domain event on PLATFORM stream (ADR-007); OpenAPI contract published + registered at gateway /api/catalog/; storefront rebuilt as Astro 7 shell (replaces nginx placeholder) listing published performances, FR/EN locale switch, ADR-004 tiers, one aggregated call per page; organizer_id on every entity. OUT: auth/authn, back-office UI (creation via API only), event editing/versioning, inventory/holds (US-003), fees/promos/rules, seat maps, event consumers (emission only - no consumer exists yet in M1).

uncertainties.note: All resolvable in Planning, none needs a product call: (1) migration tooling - none exists yet, first schema is born here; plan proposes (new-tool choice may warrant a mini-ADR); (2) OpenAPI spec-first vs code-generated - plan proposes; (3) Astro storefront joins the pnpm workspace + make check + compose (SSR container via @astrojs/node behind the gateway) - first real integration, carries ADR-006's declared risk register (gateway wiring, contract generation, CDN s-maxage honoring); (4) localizable-content shape must allow new locales without schema change (TKT-36).

dependencies.note: TKT-25 (scaffold) Done; TKT-39 (Astro spike) Done, ADR-006 Accepted, PR #4 merged. Zero open blockers.

approach.note: Catalog: chi + pgx + NATS already wired in the skeleton; add domain routes + Postgres schema (catalog DB exists per ADR-007). Gateway: route table ready, contract registration is the US-002 work it announces. Storefront: Astro 7 SSR (@astrojs/node), Cache-Control per route class via src/middleware.ts, availability-free cached HTML per the ADR-006 ownership rule, i18n.routing for FR/EN. Performance is the first dated slot - shape must not preclude festival/park days (ADR-005).

first_slice.note: The story is itself the M1 slice: create via API -> published -> visible on storefront in a browser. Demoable alone.
